name: Tea Math Lab
description: Best-effort hooks for swapping sine/cosine and overriding common runtime pi calculations.

global-math-hooks.name: Enable global math hooks
global-math-hooks.description: Enable best-effort hooks for runtime math symbols; may affect unrelated calculations.

swap-sin-cos.name: Swap sine and cosine
swap-sin-cos.description: Swap supported runtime sin/cos calls routed through hooked symbols.

custom-pi.name: Custom pi
custom-pi.description: Value used for common runtime pi-producing calls such as acos(-1) and atan2(±0, negative x).
